summary: The legal string has at most 100 characters, and complete-domain timing cannot reliably separate one counting pass from repeated native string-count scans once harness and C-level operation costs dominate.

workload_bound.source_constraint: s has length from 1 through 100 inclusive

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation performs one Counter update per input character and one table lookup per character during stable filtering. It therefore performs at most 100 updates and 100 filter lookups, plus output construction.

Authored cases cover k = 1, counts exactly equal to k, all characters qualifying, no characters qualifying, interleaved retained occurrences, one qualifying letter, and a maximum-length 100-character string with counts on both sides of the threshold.
